test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is a Tamil Nadu bus conductor, known for planting 3 lakh saplings over 30 years, has won multiple awards for his eco-activism?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Marimuthu Yoganathan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marimuthu Yoganathan** is a **bus conductor** from the state of **Tamil Nadu, India**, who has dedicated his life to **environmental conservation**.
 
• He is widely recognized for his remarkable achievement of **planting over 3 lakh saplings** over a span of **30 years**.
 
• He has been actively involved in **eco-activism** while simultaneously working as a bus conductor in the **Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation (TNSTC)**.
 
• Marimuthu Yoganathan's efforts have earned him several **awards and accolades** for his contributions to **environmental sustainability**.
 
• He is also known for **educating the public**, especially students, about the importance of **tree plantation and environmental protection**.
 
• Despite his modest background, he has made a significant impact by using his **personal resources and time** for this noble cause.
 
• His initiative has inspired many others to take up **environmental conservation** as a personal responsibility.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **MS Swaminathan**__

 __
 
• **MS Swaminathan** is known as the **Father of the Indian Green Revolution**.
 
• He played a key role in developing and introducing **high-yielding varieties (HYVs) of crops** in India, leading to increased agricultural productivity.
 
• His work primarily focused on **food security** and sustainable agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Vijay Kumar**__
 __
 
• The name **Vijay Kumar** does not directly relate to notable environmental or eco-activism contributions in the context of this question.
 
 
 
• **Sundar Pichai**__
 
 
• **Sundar Pichai** is the **CEO of Alphabet Inc. and Google**.
 
• He is a well-known figure in the **technology and innovation sector**, not directly associated with environmental activism.
 
• He was born in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India**, and has had a significant impact on **global technology advancements**.
